learning_outcomes.text: Acquire practical skills and knowledge about the main machining processes.
Acquire practical skills and knowledge about the machines and tools applied in main machining processes.
Acquire practical skills and knowledge about basic terms of manufacturing technologies.
Acquire practical skills and knowledge about tolerance assurance during machining operations.

syllabus_topics: Technological characteristics, kinematical schemes of cutting, design and geometrical parameters of cutting tools, forces and power of cutting, wear of tools, different regimes for machining
Types, purpose and design specifics of metal cutting machines
assessment_rules: The course finishes with a written exam. Students solve two problems and answer four relatively short questions. The exam is assessed in points.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
